tool: inline measurement by tools/p_dark.py parameters, L5b
question: Does a second, independent, sharper source separate the neutral-black IC packages that M08 closed as CANNOT DETERMINE?

source.licence: LINK ONLY per images/airtag/CATALOG.md - iFixit teardown imagery, not clearly relicensable
source.handling: fetched to a session scratchpad OUTSIDE the repository, measured, deleted. No image byte entered the repo. No account, no login, nothing sent.

resolution.probe: tools/m_resolution_probe.py, the SAME probe on both, on comparable board regions
resolution.verdict: the link-only source carries about 1.9x more GENUINE resolution at the board. That is a real gain, not stored-pixel inflation.

looked_at: native-resolution tiles: the nRF52832 laser marking is crisp, and the neutral-black packages 05XI 1A8 and 60LM 2405 have unmistakable straight boundaries against the soldermask. A human separates them easily.
verdict: CANNOT DETERMINE, and the reason has MOVED
finding: Neither LUMA nor LOCAL TEXTURE separates the packages from bare soldermask on this sharper source. Package luma medians 61 and 73 sit INSIDE the soldermask range 52-145; local-sd medians 9.94 and 4.22 sit inside the soldermask range 5.17-14.59. The p_dark.py threshold sweep returns ZERO candidates at every level from 70 to 120, for the same reason M08 gave: dark and smooth merges with bare soldermask and the whole board connects into one blob.
what_changed: M08 CANNOT DETERMINE is now confirmed on an INDEPENDENT and 1.9x sharper source, so it is not an artefact of one photograph. But the gap is now a METHOD gap and not a SOURCE gap: the packages ARE visible, by their straight boundaries and coherent rectangular shape, and this test only ruled out intensity and texture.
named_next_step: a BOUNDARY-based detector - straight-line detection and rectangle assembly - which is what a human eye is actually using here. Untried. It carries its own operator-dependence risk and would need the same sweep-stability admission rule. It would also need MIRROR-AWARE registration into this project frame: the iFixit image is left-right flipped, its silkscreen reads mirrored, and it carries NO scale of its own.
not_claimed: no package position, size or count is published from this source. Nothing was drawn.
